rules.trigger: a request on `/a2a`

inputs.source: an optional bearer or federation credential

effects: a principal whose scopes are dropped; the AE preflight decides the rest
rules.summary: An absent credential is anonymous and a present bearer's scopes are dropped: a bearer does not gate this route, an evaluator does.

rules.trigger: a gateway dispatch that an evaluator covers

inputs.source: the action envelope, the presented mandate, the deployed policy revision
the actor's recent decisions, when the evaluator asks for them (post-360 row K); carried on the evidence record
inputs.freshness: the journal, read in the background once an evaluator that asks for history is attached (unavailable until then), and kept current by every record appended

inputs.source: from a routing door (post-360 row R), the destination decided on with its declared locality and the request's data class; carried on the evidence record with the destinations already refused
inputs.scope: this request; the locality is the provider's own `llm-meta` declaration
inputs.freshness: the provider's ad as gossiped; the class as classified at the door

inputs.source: a fleet counter's seats — consensus decisions under `consensus/life/`, slot `ae-seat/…` (post-360 row K2, `HistoryScope::FleetConsensus`); a permit then claims a seat by consensus before admission
inputs.freshness: this node's replica for the hint; the claim is a consensus round, `Indeterminate` without a quorum

inputs.source: the fleet tally — every enforcement point's `sys/ae-tally/` entries and heartbeats (post-360 row K2, `HistoryScope::FleetTally`)
inputs.scope: this node and every peer whose heartbeat is fresh
inputs.freshness: as gossiped: `control_max_staleness_ms`, with this node's view under the governors' confidence bound; approximate (detection, not prevention); a member with no heartbeat, a stale one or one from the future is unknown coverage, and the tally is not established

effects: the evidence journal record before dispatch; the audit chain reference under `compliance`

a fleet-consensus permit: a seat decided by consensus after the per-actor gate is released, held a window from admission and then released by its holder, leased for the rule's window plus a margin as the crash fallback (row K2)
a fleet-tally permit: this node's `sys/ae-tally/` entry and heartbeat (row K2)
rules.summary: Permit, deny or indeterminate, recorded before the work runs; a refused mandate denies before policy runs, so a policy engine cannot launder a revocation. A history limit counts at the scope its rule names: this point, a consensus counter (exact; a seat claimed before admission) or the gossiped tally (approximate, and not established when its coverage is not).

rules.trigger: a resolve, a demand, the offline check, a group filter

inputs.source: `cap/` advertisements as gossiped
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

rules.summary: The one matching rule, shared by the resolver and the offline check: namespace, name, schema id, typed attribute constraints; opacity skips, it does not unmatch.

rules.trigger: an electorate adoption, declaration or genesis answer; a committed genesis found at start or arriving by gossip; an inbound copy of this node's own acceptor record; every prepare and proposal for a slot

inputs.source: `[persistence]` in the node's configuration
the acceptor memory (`TaskCtx::consensus_accepted`), restored once at start
a peer's copy of `sys/consensus-accepted/{me}/{slot}` and `consensus/committed/electorate/…`, as they arrive
inputs.freshness: as gossiped; may be stale or forged

effects: `TaskCtx::acceptor_withheld` (cleared only by a restart); the counters `electorate_persistence_refused`, `acceptor_memory_empty_for_electorate`, `acceptor_promises_forgotten`; never a Layer I write
rules.summary: An electorate member must keep its promises across a restart: no `[persistence]` is refused by name at every door, an empty store is warned once its genesis is known, and a peer's copy of this node's own record above its memory withholds the slot until the next start — detection, never prevention, and only of a copy that arrives before the next higher ballot.

rules.trigger: every gateway request

inputs.source: the bearer or JWT presented, the token tables, `[oidc]`

effects: the resolved principal and granted scopes travel to the handler
rules.summary: Deny by default under `compliance`: a route needs its scope; with no credential model the gateway is open — on loopback only, since a non-loopback one refuses to start unless `gateway_allow_unauthenticated` waives it — and a table the build cannot enforce refuses to start.

rules.trigger: a hosted component calls its `mesh.emit(kind, payload)` import

inputs.source: the component's namespace, the kinds the host listed for it, and the node's `protected_rpc_kinds` — all set at instantiation

effects: the signal is emitted at cluster scope, or dropped — never sent — and counted: `mycelium_wasm_host_emits_refused_total{reason}`
rules.summary: A component emits only under `comp/{namespace}/…` or a kind the host listed for it, and never a protected RPC kind — an emit from inside the process would reach that kind's handlers unframed, past the door that checks authority.

rules.trigger: the GC tick, and every read

inputs.source: the LWW store and its HLC
the entry's TTL and the wall clock through the seam

effects: the entry removed; a tombstone where the writer deleted
rules.summary: An advertisement its writer stopped refreshing leaves the view after its TTL; a stale view is possible in between.

rules.trigger: a local write, an incoming update, an anti-entropy round

inputs.source: the LWW store and its HLC
an incoming wire frame

effects: the store (LWW by HLC), the WAL after it, the gossip shards
rules.summary: Every update converges by last-writer-wins on the HLC; propagation is unconditional and never taught a higher-layer law (detection, not prevention).

rules.trigger: the governor tick

inputs.source: the governed group's roster and floor (`grp/`, `sys/`)
inputs.scope: the group as this node sees it
inputs.freshness: as gossiped; the confidence bound applies

inputs.source: ViewConfidence (peers heard, staleness)

effects: this node joins or leaves the group (`grp/`); the control ledger
rules.summary: This node rolls to join or leave a governed group against the intent's band — after spacing and settling, and (under an enforcing profile) only on a confident view.

rules.trigger: a placed blob whose capability a `[[activation]]` names

inputs.source: the unit file (`[hosts]`, `[[presence]]`, `[[activation]]`)
the placed path, and `artifact:<hex>` references rendered to placed paths
the activation's egress proxy, started with the stem (`[activation.confine.egress]`)
inputs.freshness: local; started once, at the stem's start

effects: the operator's command — under its `[activation.confine]` profile (Seatbelt, or Landlock with seccomp) when the unit names one, else with the stem's privileges; with `[activation.confine.egress]`, confined to its egress proxy's port in a cleared environment
rules.summary: After placement the declared command hands the blob to its local runtime — confined when the unit names a profile, which a node that cannot apply it refuses by name rather than run unconfined, as it refuses one whose egress proxy is not running; a failure is an install failure at stage `activation`, retried next round.

rules.trigger: a request an egress-proxied activation's command sends through its proxy (absolute-form HTTP or `CONNECT`)

inputs.source: the activation's egress allow-list (`[activation.confine.egress] hosts`, replaced live by `Stem::set_activation_egress_hosts` / SIGHUP; lock-order row 64)
the node's egress allow-list and credential bindings (`EgressCredentials`)

effects: the request sent on over the entry's scheme with placeholders resolved by the node's gate, its answer relayed with the granted bindings' values masked; or a byte tunnel, closed when idle; `mycelium_activation_egress_total{activation, event}`
rules.summary: An activation's command reaches another host only through its proxy: a listed host by name, a credential attached by the node's gate where its binding authorises; anything else is refused with the proxy's marker, logged and counted per activation by reason (`mycelium_activation_egress_total{activation, event}`) — not recorded in the decision trace.

rules.trigger: an install that completed, before its state swaps to `Live`

inputs.source: the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

effects: `cap/` advertisement of the entry's capability, held by the install; tombstoned on withdrawal
rules.summary: A completed install advertises its capability to the mesh; the advertisement's lifetime is the install's.

rules.trigger: every provisioning round, per catalogue entry this node could host

inputs.source: capabilities().demand(filter) — `demand/` and `cap/` as gossiped
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it
inputs.freshness: as gossiped; may be stale or partial

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)
the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

inputs.source: the unit file (`[hosts]`, `[[presence]]`, `[[activation]]`)

effects: start_install (live) or the shadow lane
`mycelium_artifact_shadow_installs_total`
rules.summary: A requirement with demanding nodes and no provider, as this node sees it, makes this node a candidate installer; an observed unmet requirement is not an instruction to install.

rules.trigger: a candidate entry that passed provenance

inputs.source: the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

inputs.source: the unit file (`[hosts]`, `[[presence]]`, `[[activation]]`)
ResourceProbe (memory, disk headroom)
Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)

effects: `mycelium_artifact_ineligible_skips_total{reason}`
rules.summary: An entry providing an `llm-meta` ad is never hosted (a model's metadata is its serving node's own, post-360 row R); otherwise this node hosts the entry's kind, has install budget left, and has memory and disk headroom for it. The check has side effects (counters) and is never re-evaluated for a record.

rules.trigger: every provisioning round, first

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)
each live install's `probe()` (file present, and the activation health flag)

effects: withdraw(): the capability's advertisement is tombstoned and the install removed
`mycelium_artifact_probe_withdrawals_total`
rules.summary: A live install whose probe fails this round is withdrawn; restart ≡ provisioning brings it back.

rules.trigger: an admitted install

inputs.source: the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)
the artifact bytes, by content address (library, mesh, or store)

effects: `HostedState::Installing` → `Live` under the install token
the `{ns}/loading` tier while bytes arrive
`mycelium_artifact_installs_started_total`, `_completed_total`, `_failed_total{stage}`
rules.summary: Fetch, verify, place and host the artifact under an install token; a superseded token tears its install down rather than advertising it.

rules.trigger: a candidate entry

inputs.source: the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

inputs.source: `[hosts].trusted_reviewers`

rules.summary: A proposed entry loads live only once a listed reviewer has accepted it; until then it may load into the shadow lane only (D20).

rules.trigger: every provisioning round, per `[[presence]]` declaration

inputs.source: capabilities().demand(filter) — `demand/` and `cap/` as gossiped
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it
inputs.freshness: as gossiped; may be stale or partial

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)
the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

inputs.source: the unit file (`[hosts]`, `[[presence]]`, `[[activation]]`)

effects: start_install of the smallest loadable candidate
rules.summary: Fewer live providers than the declared floor, as this node sees it, makes this node a candidate installer of the cheapest loadable entry.

rules.trigger: after activation, and on every re-probe tick

inputs.source: the unit file (`[hosts]`, `[[presence]]`, `[[activation]]`)
the declared probe argv's exit status

effects: the install's health flag, which `prov.health_pass` reads
rules.summary: The probe gates the capability: a failing initial probe is an activation error (nothing advertised); a later failure flips the health flag the next health pass withdraws on. A confined re-probe re-resolves a profile whose declared path was replaced, every check repeated, and runs under the fresh one; only a refused re-resolution (`confinement_*`), or a path that changed under every attempt (`confinement_changed`), withdraws. Recorded under the install's token; a re-probe records only a change of verdict.

rules.trigger: every provisioning round, after the health pass

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)
the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

inputs.source: the unit file (`[hosts]`, `[[presence]]`, `[[activation]]`)

effects: withdraw() of the `{name}.shadow` install once the entry is accepted, so the live rule reinstalls it
rules.summary: A shadow install whose entry a listed reviewer has since accepted is withdrawn from the shadow lane (D20).

rules.trigger: a candidate entry, before any other check

inputs.source: the signed catalogue (`installable/` as gossiped, or the library manifest)
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it

inputs.source: `[hosts].trusted_publishers`

rules.summary: An entry is a candidate only if a trusted publisher signed it; an empty trust list trusts everything, which the report says.

rules.trigger: an install about to start, when install rights are configured

inputs.source: InstallRights::ledger (lock-order row 37)
inputs.freshness: local; the head is published after

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)

effects: the ledger's admit record and published head
`mycelium_artifact_installs_refused_by_rights_total`
rules.summary: An install takes a right from this node's allocation first; under the enforcing profile a node with none left refuses, and records that it did.

rules.trigger: a candidate that passed every other check

inputs.source: `StemOptions::self_elect_p` and one draw from the `select` RNG stream (through the seam since 2026-10-03)

rules.summary: Herd damping: a candidate acts this round with probability p, drawn after the guards so a decline costs nothing. Replay-covered since the draw went through the seam.

rules.trigger: every provisioning round, per `[[presence]]` declaration with a ceiling

inputs.source: capabilities().demand(filter) — `demand/` and `cap/` as gossiped
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it
inputs.freshness: as gossiped; may be stale or partial

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)
`prov-shed/{ns}:{name}:{hash}` advertisements — which providers will act on this band's shed
inputs.scope: the fleet as this node sees it
inputs.freshness: as gossiped; may be stale or partial

inputs.source: when each unmarked peer was first seen unmarked (`Provisioner::unmarked_since`) — fixed only after FIXED_AFTER
inputs.freshness: local, monotonic clock through the replay seam

effects: withdraw() of this node's install
`mycelium_artifact_presence_sheds_total`
`mycelium_artifact_presence_unranked_departures_total` and a warning when the band fell below its ceiling as unmarked providers left
rules.summary: More live providers than the declared ceiling withdraws the hosts ranked beyond it by the band's rendezvous order, among the providers that advertise they will act on it (`prov-shed`; rev 2; rev 1 drew per host, and every host could withdraw at once).

rules.trigger: a health-pass failure, a promotion, a shed, or a superseded install

inputs.source: Provisioner::hosted (lock-order row 21)

effects: the install removed under row 21, then uninstalled outside it; the advertisement tombstoned
rules.summary: Withdrawal removes the install and tombstones its advertisement; restart ≡ provisioning is how it comes back.

rules.trigger: a protected RPC kind arriving at a provider with enforcement on

inputs.source: the node's evaluator and execution authority; the carried mandate

effects: the evidence journal; the handler never runs on a refusal
rules.summary: Authority where the work happens: a protected call is checked at the provider whichever door it came through; with enforcement on and no evaluator it is refused, with it off nothing is checked.

rules.trigger: a signal arriving at this node, local or forwarded

inputs.source: the signal's scope and this node's boundary groups (`grp/`)
the gossip shards' fill and the handlers' fill

effects: delivery to local handlers; the sender log

trace.partial: refusals and sheds only; an admitted signal is the hot path and records nothing

rules.summary: Admission is scoped (Cluster · Group · Individual) and shed under load — except Individual and the boundary transitions; shedding happens before the sender is recorded.

rules.trigger: a signal emitted or received with TTL left

inputs.source: an incoming wire frame

effects: the gossip shards
rules.summary: Forwarding is unconditional (flood fallback); only admission is scoped, and a frame addressed to this node terminates here.

rules.trigger: an admitted signal of a suppressed kind

inputs.source: the suppression table

effects: held signals delivered on flush
rules.summary: A kind can be held until a time; held signals are released on flush. Suppression never changes forwarding.
